question: The famous festival of India, Makar Sankranti is celebrated in which month?
solution:
The correct answer is __**January**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Makar Sankranti** is celebrated in the month of **January** every year.
 
• This festival marks the transition of the Sun into the zodiac sign of **Capricorn (Makara Rashi)**.
 
• It is one of the few Hindu festivals that are celebrated on a fixed date, that is, 14th January
